description: This PHP class defines a MailTransport utility that extends Symfony's AbstractTransport to facilitate sending emails via various protocols (SMTP, SMTPS, sendmail). It includes configuration methods for setting credentials, encryption, and transport mechanisms, encapsulating email transport logic within a structured class.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A custom email transport class for sending emails using SMTP, SMTPS, or sendmail protocols, built on Symfony's mailing components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport with a specified scheme (smtp, smtps, sendmail), host, and optional port. Sets up transport details based on the scheme.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads the transport mechanism, creating a DSN object with current configuration, and initializes the mailTransport property.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures encryption options for the transport, specifically disabling peer verification if the encryption type is not TLS.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Performs the email sending operation using the configured transport.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport configuration.
